instruction: Have Glitch plug the data shard into his deck and crack whatever is on it.

target.reason: The instruction wants Glitch to plug the data shard into his deck and crack its contents, but the page offers no verb for using, plugging in, or cracking an item — only depart, speak, and give/take. None of the available end states (holding an item, being in a room, or having spoken) captures cracking the shard; even moving the shard from rogue to glitch would only change its holder, not crack what is on it.
